name: Deep-pool lead shallow-pool catch-up
hypothesis: Buy the lagging pool after a verified deep-pool move if the remaining net catch-up exceeds cost at current size.
spec: Setup: A deeper market may reveal demand before another tradeable pool updates. Entry: Buy the lagging pool after a verified deep-pool move if the remaining net catch-up exceeds cost at current size. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit as the price gap closes or the deep market reverses. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs synchronized multi-pool DEX quotes (not connected)
